provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Harry Potter: Death Eaters Rising rulebook (USAopoly, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Connect the 3 Location boards; Lord Voldemort figure in the center facing a random Place
Stack each Location's two Place cards faceup in random order
steps.note: Ministry: Department of Mysteries, The Atrium; Diagon Alley: Ollivander's, Gringotts; Hogsmeade: Hog's Head Inn, Train Platform

steps.text: Spell Tokens facedown on the table
Damage and Corruption counters in a supply
Each player chooses an Affiliation (two may share one): Hogwarts, Order of the Phoenix or Dumbledore's Army
Take its Headquarters card, one of its starting characters and a Mission token
steps.note: Hogwarts: Dumbledore / McGonagall; Order: Tonks / Sirius; DA: Harry / Hermione

steps.text: Set aside the Lord Voldemort card
Shuffle all other Character cards (unused starting characters and Death Eaters too) into a draw pile
{n} Character cards faceup next to each of the 3 Places
You lose if 4+ Places or one whole Location is corrupted, or too many Wizards fall
Whoever most recently watched a Harry Potter movie goes first; play is clockwise
